title: Regional Sales Manager (Food Testing)
description:
**Company Description**
**About QIMA:**
 At QIMA, our Food Division is dedicated to helping every member of the global food supply chain ensure the safety and quality of food products, as well as safe working conditions and sustainable practices. With inspections, audits and certifications, we support food growers, producers and retailers, as well as businesses in food service and hospitality, securing their food products' journey from farm to shelf and fork.
   

  

 Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
   

  

**EFRAC** 
 , part of QIMA group is a laboratory testing services company focusing on food safety, pharmaceutical quality control, and environmental monitoring.
   

  

 What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Role in Brief**
 We are looking for a motivated and experienced Regional Sales Manager to join our team and lead sales initiatives targeting
 **Food Industries** 
 . Regional Business Deveopment Manager Should have worked in
 **TIC domain (Specifically for the Sale of Food Testing Services)** 
 for not less than
 **06 Years**
 The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of identifying opportunities, building strong relationships, and closing deals in
 **the Food industry** 
 .
   

  

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to target food industries and drive revenue growth.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through existing Clientele, cold calling, networking, and market research.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision\-makers in the food industry.
* Prepare and deliver tailored presentations and proposals to prospective clients.
* Negotiate contracts and close deals to meet or exceed sales targets.
* Collaborate with internal teams such as marketing, customer service, and operations to ensure client satisfaction.
* Provide regular updates and reports on sales activities and progress to senior management.
* Manage a group of sales reps


**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to drive revenue growth for the food testing business. This includes identifying target markets, creating detailed marketing strategies, defining clear objectives to expand the customer base and increase market share.
* Partner and collaborate with industry stakeholders such as food manufacturers, processors, exporters, importers, regulatory bodies etc. Foster relationships with key decision\-makers like quality assurance managers, procurement heads, and health and safety officials.
* Provide leadership and guidance to to the sales team, ensuring team members have the skills, knowledge, and motivation to achieve sales targets. This involves coaching, mentoring, conducting performance reviews, and facilitating continuous professional development opportunities to maximize team effectiveness.
* Evaluate and decide on new business opportunities and sales tactics by assessing market trends \& competitor activities.


**Qualifications**
**Profile Requirements**
**To Succeed In This Role, You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Science or a related field.
* Minimum of 06 years of sales experience in ISO 17025:2017 accredited Lab/s for Food Testing Services in the food industry.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and closing deals.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Hands\-on experience
* Proficient in Computer Skills, CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience selling Food Testing Services to food industry.
* Strong Existing network of contacts within the food industry.


 If you possess the skills and experience required for this role and are passionate about driving business growth in the food industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as our Regional Sales Manager.
   

  

**So, READY TO BECOME A QIMATE? JOIN US!**
**Additional Information**
**Why You Should Join Us**
* Competitive salary package with performance bonuses.
* A wealth of opportunities for professional development.
* A truly flexible and fully remote working environment.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge technologies and digital transformation.


 Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next steps within 15 days from the date of submission.

title: Inside Sales Representative (Indian Market)
description:
Qureos is redefining how companies hire with AI. Backed by leading investors including Prosus Ventures and COTU Ventures, Qureos recently raised a $5 million Seed round to accelerate the future of hiring.
 



  
 



 Trusted by 1,000\+ enterprise and public sector organizations, Qureos helps companies compress hiring timelines from months to as little as six days through AI\-powered sourcing, screening, and interviewing.
 



  
 



 Our platform distributes jobs across 2,000\+ global channels, screens candidates in under 15 seconds, and automates recruitment workflows at scale, turning hiring from an operational bottleneck into a competitive advantage.
 



  
 



 As demand accelerates globally, we are expanding our commercial team with ambitious, high\-performing sales professionals who want to help build one of the fastest\-growing AI hiring companies in the region while driving our go\-to\-market expansion across the India market.
 



  
 



**Why Join Qureos?** 




  
 



 Recruitment is one of the largest and most operationally complex industries in the world, yet most companies still rely on outdated and disconnected workflows. Qureos is changing that.
 



  
 



 We are building the infrastructure layer for modern hiring, an AI\-native recruitment platform that helps companies move faster, hire smarter, and scale efficiently across global markets, with India being a key strategic growth market for our GTM expansion.
 



  
 



 This is an opportunity to join a category\-defining company at an early growth stage, work directly alongside ambitious operators, and play a meaningful role in shaping how hiring works globally.
 



  
 



**What We’re Looking For** 




  
 



 ✔️ 1–5 years of inside sales, account executive, business development, or closing experience in SaaS, AI, HRTech, recruitment, or tech sales
 



 ✔️ Proven track record of consistently hitting or exceeding revenue targets in high\-growth or go\-to\-market environments
 



 ✔️ Strong understanding of the Indian market, including experience selling to businesses, HR teams, or decision\-makers across India
 



 ✔️ Excellent communication skills across calls, video meetings, and written conversations
 



 ✔️ Experience using CRM and remote sales tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoom, or similar platforms
 



 ✔️ Strong understanding of outbound sales, pipeline management, and GTM execution strategies
 



 ✔️ Previous experience selling into the Indian market or working with Indian clients is highly preferred
 



 ✔️ Previous experience in recruitment, HRTech, AI products, or B2B SaaS is a strong plus
 



  
 



**What You’ll Do** 




  
 



 ✔️ Own the full sales cycle from discovery call to signed contract, driving revenue growth across the India market through inbound and qualified opportunities
 



 ✔️ Execute go\-to\-market strategies to expand Qureos’ presence across India’s enterprise, SMB, and recruitment sectors
 



 ✔️ Run high\-quality discovery calls, product demos, negotiations, and commercial conversations with HR leaders and decision\-makers
 



 ✔️ Work closely with SDRs, marketing, customer success, and leadership to improve conversion and buyer experience
 



  
 



**What We Offer** 




  
 



 ✔️ Competitive base salary with uncapped commission structure
 



 ✔️ Opportunity to join a high\-growth, VC\-backed AI company scaling across global markets
 



 ✔️ Fully remote work environment with flexibility and autonomy
 



 ✔️ Clear career progression into enterprise sales, leadership, strategic accounts, or GTM leadership roles
 



 ✔️ Direct exposure to experienced founders, operators, and investors

title: Sales Closer
description:
HAKELIZE TECHWORKS is a creative technology studio built for brands that want more than visibility — they want meaning, momentum, and measurable growth. We turn ideas into identities, experiences into systems, and businesses into brands people remember. With a global vision and a sharp eye for detail, we help companies move with clarity, stand out with confidence, and scale with intelligence.
 







 About the role
 



  





 You will own the early and mid stages of the sales cycle: identifying prospects, starting conversations, qualifying opportunities, and moving leads toward conversion. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is confident in outreach, comfortable speaking with prospects, and motivated by performance. You will work closely with the Founders and play an important role in shaping how we grow in new markets.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong consultative selling skills, including prospect qualification, solution presentation, negotiation, and closing.
* Experience in B2B sales for digital services such as web development, performance marketing, social media management, or software solutions.
* Solid business Insights and understanding of SMEs, startups, and brand growth in digital markets.
* Prior experience in agency, SaaS, or tech sales in the Indian/asia region or similar markets is an advantage.



  





 What you will do
 


* Identify and engage potential clients
* Build meaningful business relationships
* Drive sales conversations from first contact to closing
* Understand customer needs and communicate our solutions effectively
* Work closely with Founders on growth initiatives
* Help expand our reach into global markets
* Contribute to building a strong and repeatable sales process







 What you bring
 



  




* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Confidence in handling conversations with prospects
* Self\-driven mindset with the ability to work independently
* Previous sales experience is a plus
* Someone who takes ownership and enjoys building from the ground up
* A proactive attitude and willingness to learn quickly







 About the team and culture
 



  





 At HAKELIZE TECHWORKS, we value ownership, initiative, and collaboration. We are a lean, fast\-moving team where ideas are heard, effort is recognized, and performance matters. You will work directly with the Founders in an environment that encourages accountability, creativity, and growth. We believe in building with purpose, moving with clarity, and creating opportunities for people who want to make a real impact.
 







 What you get
 



  




* Hybrid/Remote working model
* Performance\-driven commission structure
* Opportunity to earn more than a regular sales job
* Direct collaboration with Founders
* Growth opportunity with a global vision







 Your income has no ceiling.
 



  





 Your ambition sets the number.
 



 Not confined to South Asia. Built for the world.
 



 Because ideas need champions.
 



  





 Businesses need closers.
 







 If you’re ready to make an impact, send your resume to (We will only be reviewing resumes sent directly to our email.):
 



 admin@hakelizetechworks.com
 



 HAKELIZE TECHWORKS

title: Major Account Manager - Conglomerates
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 Working together with a Solutions Consultant,, you will be responsible for growing your territory. You are the primary point\-of\-contact for India’s one of the largest conglomerate group and are accountable for delivering above quota sales performance in your region. You are motivated by a hunger to solve critically difficult challenges that face our clients. You develop trusted relationships at a high, executive level, focusing on the strategic nature of the partnership. This means that you have a concrete understanding of our product suites, and are able to help identify areas that can be resolved by Palo Alto Networks solutions.
   

  

 You will lead to identifying and signing appropriate channel partners as well as training them on our solutions. Additionally, your credibility will guide your customers in their search to transition to a more secure online environment. You feel empowered by our product offerings \- and love a technical challenge.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* You will specifically be responsible for managing a strategic Conglomerate group
* Employing world\-class account management skills to identify cross\-selling and up\-selling opportunities within the target accounts
* Be a highly competent presenter, with a proven track record in selling to C level executives
* Develop and maintain detailed account profiles including organisational charts for all accounts to be reviewed by management on a quarterly basis
* Facilitate communication on strategic and tactical issues facing our clients and partners
* Maintain continuity and up\-to\-date knowledge of industry trends, technical developments, and governmental regulations that affect target markets
* Develop market strategies and goals for each product and service; understand the strategies, goals, and objectives of accounts
* Lead coordinating account strategy and tactics for sales support team (inside sales, systems engineering, sales management)
* Take full responsibility for accurate sales forecasting by demonstrating in\-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact through the procurement process
* Extensive domestic travel and possible International travel as necessary


**Qualifications**
**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Hiwaga Makers is a 360° advertising and marketing agency that supports businesses with strategy, creative execution, and integrated media solutions across digital and traditional platforms. The team designs performance\-focused campaigns spanning marketing strategy, content and brand development, video production, social media management, influencer marketing, PR support, and OOH advertising. Based in Kottayam, Kerala, Hiwaga Makers has partnered with over 200 clients in healthcare, retail, hospitality, personal brands, education, and lifestyle sectors across 6 countries. The agency emphasizes structured, intentional marketing aligned with business goals, prioritizing clarity, systems, and long\-term partnerships over short\-term noise. Applicants joining Hiwaga Makers will work in an environment that treats marketing as a system built for sustainable growth and collaboration.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Manager is a full\-time hybrid role based in Kottayam, with flexibility for some work\-from\-home arrangements. This role is responsible for identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, nurturing leads, and building long\-term client relationships across multiple industries and markets. Day\-to\-day tasks include prospecting and outreach, conducting discovery meetings, preparing proposals and presentations, coordinating with internal strategy and creative teams, and managing the sales pipeline using CRM tools. The Business Development Manager will analyze market trends, collaborate on campaign pitches, negotiate contracts, and ensure smooth handover from closing deals to account management. The role also involves setting growth targets, tracking performance metrics, and representing Hiwaga Makers at events, online meetings, and partner engagements to drive structured, sustainable revenue growth.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Business development and sales skills, including prospecting, lead qualification, client relationship management, and deal negotiation.
* Marketing and advertising knowledge, with understanding of digital campaigns, social media, content marketing, and integrated media solutions.
* Strategic thinking and analytical skills to assess market opportunities, interpret campaign performance data, and align solutions with client business goals.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to conduct discovery calls, pitch proposals, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Organizational and planning abilities, including pipeline management, CRM usage, documentation, and time management in a fast\-paced environment.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in an agency, media, or marketing services environment is preferred; familiarity with industries such as healthcare, retail, or hospitality is an advantage.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup from Kottayam, with readiness for client meetings, occasional travel, and collaboration across remote and in\-office teams.

title: SAT Counsellor – International Sales (US Market)
description:
**About the Role** 




 As an SAT Counsellor, you'll own the full sales cycle for our SAT test\-prep offering in the US market — engaging prospective students and parents, understanding their college\-admissions goals, and consultatively closing them into the right program. This is a target\-driven, individual\-contributor closing role where your product knowledge, empathy and communication skills directly drive enrollments and revenue.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Engage prospective students and parents in the US market via calls, video counselling, instant messaging (WhatsApp) and other channels to sell ACE Academy's SAT test\-prep courses.
* Understand each student's college\-admissions goals, academic background and timeline, and recommend the most suitable SAT program through consultative selling.
* Own the complete sales funnel from lead qualification and product demonstration to closing, enrollment and post\-sale relationship.
* Drive conversions through effective follow\-ups, strong objection handling, and clear articulation of the value of our SAT prep.
* Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly enrollment and revenue targets.
* Handle high\-value / premium student profiles while maintaining an exceptional customer experience.
* Maintain accurate lead, activity and pipeline records in the CRM.
* Deliver a student\-first experience that generates referrals and repeat business.



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* 2–5 years of experience selling SAT / test\-prep or study\-abroad courses to US consumers (international EdTech sales strongly preferred).
* Bachelor's degree (graduation) in any discipline is required.
* Proven, documented track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth as an individual contributor.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication fluency is essential for engaging US students and parents.
* Strong understanding of the cultural nuances and buying behaviour of US\-based students and families.
* Ability to listen effectively, build trust, and approach prospects with patience and empathy.
* Proficiency with CRM tools / sales tracking software and basic MS Office.
* Familiarity with the SAT, US college\-admissions process, or the test\-prep industry is a strong added advantage.
* Comfortable working a 6\-day week on a US\-aligned night shift, including weekends.
* High\-energy, self\-motivated and results\-oriented, able to work fast and independently in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary plus uncapped performance\-based incentives.
* The chance to sell a Forbes\-recognised, globally trusted education brand.
* Warm, high\-intent leads from a large international market.
* WFH flexibility
